messages:
maria: FYI we've observed the same eviction-driven latency spike pattern in 3 separate postmortems (kv-cache eviction -> token latency spike -> autoscaler thrash). I'm starting this thread to lock down runbook/playbook edits and owners.

sam: Thanks for surfacing. Can you drop the short summary + proposed triage steps here so I can add to the incident follow-ups doc?

maria: TL;DR: root cause = sudden KV cache churn during GC/OOM cycles on a subset of hosts. Impact = increased P50/P95 token latency, followed by autoscaler scaling that made cold starts worse. Proposed immediate edits to triage/playbook: 
- Add a top-level health check: `kv-cache-utilization` and `kv-cache-eviction-rate`.
- Add explicit command to pin to a lower-memory model variant when eviction > threshold.
- Add fallback routing rule to burst to a cheaper but compatible model if steady-state eviction persists.

anya: I'll own the runbook updates. Assign RW-4582 to me. Target delivery: 2026-03-30.

leo: I'll own dashboards/alerting changes (panels + thresholds). Estimated ETA: 48 hours.

devon: Adding the quick operational commands we used in the postmortem for on-call folks:
```
# check eviction and mem pressure
curl -sS "https://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=kv_cache_eviction_rate"
# quick workaround: reduce serving batch size for affected pool
redwoodctl deploy --pool pool-kv --set batch_size=8 
# pin to variant v2-small temporarily
redwoodctl route set --model my-model --variant v2-small
```

maria: And an explicit escalation path in the playbook: if `kv_cache_eviction_rate > 5%` for 5m -> page eng-oncall + pager to SRE lead, plus immediate canary rollback to previous model variant.

oncall-bot: IncidentBot: ticket RW-4582 created and assigned to @anya. Due date set to 2026-03-30.

sam: Can we add a one-line quick checklist at the top of the runbook (for first responders)? Something like:
- Check cache metrics -> run workaround commands -> pin variant -> notify SRE/owners.

anya: Yes. I'll add a "Quick triage" one-liner + an owner matrix (who does model pin, who modifies routing, who updates capacity). Putting first draft in a PR by EOD tomorrow.

leo: I'll wire up a dedicated panel for `kv_cache_eviction_rate`, `kv_cache_hit_ratio`, and a composite alert that suppresses flapping by requiring 3 consecutive 1m buckets.

maria: Action items (explicit):
- anya: runbook edit (RW-4582) — due 2026-03-30
- leo: dashboards + composite alert — due 2026-03-27
- sam: add playbook one-liner + owner matrix — due 2026-03-26
- devon: ops repo command snippets + example `redwoodctl` invocations — due EOD today

sam: ack on owners and dates, will follow up on the PR and link to the postmortem.

maria: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if RW-4582 has blockers after the first PR review. Closing this check-in for now. :white_check_mark:
